findings.current:
The voice that slipped out as if in soliloquy held neither regret nor anger or curse.

It was encouragement the listener couldn’t understand, and at the same time, deep regret.

Regret at not being able to witness the astonishing amusement that lay ahead.
findings.defect: The narration explicitly excludes regret, then the draft calls his feeling regret twice.
findings.rationale: 아쉬움 is disappointment at missing what comes next; 후회, regret, is expressly ruled out.
findings.replacement:
The voice that slipped out as if in soliloquy held neither regret, anger, nor a curse.

It was encouragement the listener couldn’t understand, tinged with deep disappointment.

He would miss the astonishing amusement that lay ahead.
findings.source:
혼잣말처럼 흘러나온 음성에 담긴 감정은 후회도, 분노나 저주도 아니었다.

그것은 듣는 이조차 이해할 수 없었던 격려인 동시에 짙은 아쉬움이었다.

앞으로 일어날 놀라운 유희를 경험하지 못한다는 사실로부터 비롯된 아쉬움.

findings.current: You have achieved the great feat [Dragon Slayer]!
findings.defect: This makes the feat’s name identical to the separately awarded Dragon Slayer title and retains square brackets around a System term.
findings.rationale: The source names the feat 용살자 and the later title 드래곤 슬레이어; they are distinct labels.
findings.replacement: You have achieved the great feat Dragon Killer!

findings.current: You have defeated [Lv. 195 “Black Dragon Duke” Morgoth]!
findings.defect: Square brackets remain around a name and level inside the System panel.
findings.rationale: The panel’s blockquote supplies the UI framing; the binding Markdown rule removes brackets from notices.
findings.replacement: You have defeated Lv. 195 “Black Dragon Duke” Morgoth!

findings.current: You have acquired the Title [Dragon Slayer]!
findings.defect: Square brackets remain around the title inside the System panel.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rule excludes square brackets around System terms.
findings.replacement: You have acquired the Title Dragon Slayer!

findings.current: his depleted will had already made every preparation to defy its owner.
findings.defect: The draft makes his will itself defy him; the source says his exhausted mental strength is about to override his will.
findings.rationale: 정신력 and 주인의 의지 are separate here: depleted mental reserves can no longer obey Jin’s determination to stay awake.
findings.replacement: his exhausted mind was already poised to defy his will.
findings.source: 바닥난 정신력은 이미 주인의 의지를 거스를 만반의 준비를 끝마친 뒤였으니.

findings.current: The Jin Taekyung he knew had a remarkable instinct, every bit as remarkable as his foul temper.
findings.rationale: 놀라운 힘과 직감 names both power and instinct.
findings.replacement: The Jin Taekyung he knew had power and instincts as remarkable as his foul temper.
findings.source: 그가 아는 진태경은 그 고약한 성미만큼이나 놀라운 힘과 직감을 지닌 사람이니까.

findings.defect: The line becomes praise for performance rather than acknowledgment of what Jin endured.
findings.rationale: 고생했다 recognizes hardship and effort, fitting the exchange between exhausted friends.

summary: The draft contradicts Morgoth’s stated emotion, conflates a System feat with a title, and omits Jin Taekyung’s power from the Undead King’s assessment. Several localized corrections remain.
